name: mem-tool
description: The main agent (off mode, Ask each time) calls the memory tool five times through the synthetic endpoint: save a fact (this project), save a fact at user level, save a TASTE rule, update the fact, a refused call (a TASTE rule at user level) and delete the TASTE rule. After each successful call the Memory page reads what View in Memory opens. Mori restarts, the session is opened again and two cards are followed again (the deleted TASTE entry reads as null).
notes: Setup (synthetic test setup, docs/specs/memory.md §14.1): model-config.json has one local provider MEM (fake-coder; fake-think marked Supports thinking; fake-coder-404) on the synthetic endpoint http://127.0.0.1:4770/v1, default range mem/fake-coder, profiles given as verified; enhancement replies come from the synthetic enhancement script (FAKE_ENHANCE_SCRIPT)
